parts.name: Steering
parts.description: The steering stem, the triple clamps (bottom and top bridges) and the head bearings that let the front end turn.
parts.function: Connects the fork to the frame's steering head so the front wheel can turn. The 28° rake and 110 mm trail give the bike its stable, easy steering.

parts.name: Steering Stem / Bottom Bridge
parts.description: The lower triple clamp with its integral stem, which passes up through the frame's steering head.
parts.function: Clamps the lower ends of the fork tubes and rotates on the steering-head bearings.

parts.name: Top Bridge
parts.description: The upper triple clamp. The handlebar risers and meter are drawn mounted to it.
parts.function: Clamps the tops of the fork tubes, retains the steering stem and carries the handlebar.
parts.verificationNote: The Honda diagram name and part number are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Steering Head Bearings
parts.description: Bearings in the top and bottom of the frame's steering head.
parts.function: Let the steering turn smoothly with no free play.
parts.verificationNote: Bearing type and part numbers are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.
